case_narrative.description: Free-text case notes; may contain highly sensitive detail.

contact.description: Phone number or e-mail used for notices.

eligibility_outcome.description: Result of an eligibility determination and its evidence summary.

income.description: Declared or verified monthly household income.

national_id.description: Government-issued national identifier used for identity proofing only.

payment_status.description: Disbursement status, amount and exception reason.

lawful_bases.consent: Processing based on recorded, revocable consent of the data subject.
lawful_bases.legal_obligation: Processing required by another law (e.g. public finance rules).
lawful_bases.public_service_mandate: Processing necessary to deliver a mandated public service.
lawful_bases.statutory_authority: Processing required by the social protection statute.
lawful_bases.vital_interest: Processing to protect life or physical safety.

case_management.description: Manage an assigned case, including sensitive narratives.

eligibility_verification.description: Determine whether a person meets program eligibility rules.

emergency_protection.description: Exceptional access to protect a person at immediate risk. Requires an approved, active, time-bounded break-glass grant naming the subject and the attributes.

enrollment.description: Enrol an eligible person in a program and manage entitlement.

external_verification.description: Just-in-time resolution of an identifier so that an authoritative external source can be queried for an assertion. The resolved value must never be persisted by the caller.

grievance_handling.description: Resolve a complaint or appeal lodged by a beneficiary.

identity_proofing.description: Verify identity and create or look up the internal person token.

payment_execution.description: Produce and execute a disbursement instruction through a payment provider.

payment_status_inquiry.description: Check the status of a payment without seeing payment credentials.

registration.description: Capture and maintain registration data for a household or person.

retention_processing.description: Execute retention expiry actions (archive, anonymise, delete).

token_resolution.description: Resolve an opaque token to direct identifiers for a service that must present them externally.

breakglass.grant.basis: Exceptional access records are kept for independent audit.

broker.verification_cache.basis: Cached assertions must be re-verified daily.

eligibility.determination.basis: Re-verification cycle; stale determinations must not be reused.

payment_reference.instrument.basis: Instrument retained only while an enrollment is active plus one year.

identity_status.question: Is the identity verified and the person alive?

residence.question: Is the person resident in the requested district?

disability_eligibility.question: Does the person hold a certification that qualifies for the program?

income_band.question: Which income band is the person in?

income_threshold.question: Is declared annual income below the program threshold?

tax-authority.description: National tax authority income verification service.
